title: Consensus Player — Accessibility Fix Backlog (a754d887d)
sources: Claude: consensus-player-a11y-audit-by-team.md (prior; corrected by this pass)

items.title: Brand orange fails WCAG AA text contrast everywhere it is used
items.detail: Systematic scan of 69 distinct text styles across three pages: 18 failed. Root cause is brand orange rgb(252,104,57) — white-on-orange 2.93:1 and orange-on-white 2.93:1 / orange-on-#F0F0F0 2.57:1. Affects Contact me, Select all, Continue, Get in touch, JW avatar (still fails 3:1 large-text), legal links, and modal headings. Design-system-level fix, not per-component.
items.fix: Darken or recolor brand orange text/on-orange tokens to ≥4.5:1 (normal) and ≥3:1 (large text / UI); ship contrast-safe text and button variants in the design system.

items.title: Topic-rating checkboxes are 0×0 and skipped by Tab
items.detail: Re-verified in the full Tab walk: after the info icon, focus lands on body because the three rating checkboxes render at 0×0px. Chrome skips them regardless of tabIndex. Now confirmed on all three demos.
items.fix: Give inputs real dimensions matching visible icons (or move focus to a sized sibling); convert to radiogroup/radio.

items.title: Reaction-bar focus ring exists but fails 3:1 non-text contrast
items.detail: Correction: earlier reports said no visible focus. Ring is a grey box-shadow; compositing over the video bar yields only 1.34:1 (light frame) / 1.76:1 (dark frame). Exists but is not reliably visible (WCAG 1.4.11 / 2.4.11).
items.fix: Raise reaction-bar :focus-visible contrast to ≥3:1 against both light and dark video frames (or a solid control chrome).
items.verified: Claude three-mechanism focus check + compositing measurement

items.title: Seek and Volume sliders have no visible focus indicator
items.detail: Re-verified via outline, box-shadow, and border-color — all inactive. Play/Mute/Subtitles/Settings/Fullscreen use Plyr's dashed outline and pass.
items.fix: Add a visible :focus-visible style on Plyr range inputs (seek + volume).

items.title: Opt-In toggle and Select-all / Contact me (Page A) lack focus styles
items.detail: Opt-In toggle: no outline/box-shadow/border on input or sibling span. Page A Contact me and Select all also show no focus indicator (on Page B, Contact me does use the orange box-shadow — screen-specific gap).
items.fix: Apply the shared focus-visible token (border-color or two-layer ring) to Opt-In, Select all, and any Contact me variant that currently has none.

items.title: Orange focus ring depends on outer layer alone for 3:1
items.detail: Inner layer rgb(255,160,124) = 1.99:1 vs white; outer rgb(224,94,52) = 3.61:1. Combined likely adequate on light backgrounds — Design should confirm intentional layering.
items.fix: Document the two-layer ring as a deliberate token, or strengthen the inner layer so either layer alone meets 3:1.

items.title: Unused Plyr rewind/fast-forward controls are 0×0 and still focusable in DOM
items.detail: Not disabled — only visually unused / zero-sized — so Tab skips them the same way as rating checkboxes. Cleanup item.
items.fix: Remove from DOM or disable unused Plyr controls for this control-bar layout.

items.title: Country/State combobox missing role=combobox and aria-expanded
items.detail: Arrow-key + listbox/option + aria-activedescendant work; input still lacks combobox/aria-expanded. Focus uses border-color (mechanism correction from prior generic 'ring' wording).
items.fix: Add role=combobox + aria-expanded (and aria-controls) per ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern.

items.title: Corrections: several controls DO have visible focus (methodology gap)
items.detail: Reaction bar, Contact me (Page B), and Adjust my selections use box-shadow rings — previously reported as missing because only outline was checked. Lead-capture text fields use border-color, not outline/box-shadow. Pass/fail unchanged for fields; only the CSS mechanism description is corrected.
items.fix: When replicating focus styles, look for border-color and box-shadow rules — not only outline.
